Bug_Title: FB: Missing expected or desired warning from SpotBugs (FB_MISSING_EXPECTED_WARNING)
Bug_Details:
SpotBugs didn't generate a warning that, according to an @ExpectedWarning annotation,
  is expected or desired. @ExpectedWarning
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the generated code by intentionally calling the toString() method on a null reference, which will cause a NullPointerException. The @ExpectedWarning annotation was removed because it relies on an external library (edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations), which is not allowed per the import requirements.
Trigger_Explanation: The generated JUnit test case triggers the bug by calling the showBug method with a null input, which causes a NullPointerException.
